items.name: Red Dagger Ring
items.lore: A plain ring with a single red stone. Every Red Dagger wears one. Sigrid doesn't, now.

items.name: Trapper's Snow-Cloak
items.lore: White fur, thick enough to sleep in.

items.name: Bounty-Notice Charm
items.lore: Sigrid's own bounty notice, folded small. She laughs every time she sees it.

items.name: Bloodnail's Belt
items.lore: Hung with the sheaths of a dozen knives. Empty, now.

items.name: Grani's Mane-Braid
items.lore: Eight braids of grey mane, one for each leg. The gods' own horse-blood.

items.name: Fenrir Blood-Bowl Torc
items.lore: Beaten from the fenrir's blood-bowl. Scrubbed. Scrubbed again.

items.name: Breeder's Saddle-Belt
items.lore: Hroald's own, from forty years of riding.

items.name: Eight-Hoof Ring
items.lore: A ring of eight tiny silver hooves.

items.name: Jarl's Rein-Bracer
items.lore: The bracer of a jarl's horse-master.

items.name: Icestrider-Shell Bracer
items.lore: Pale shell, cold as the fells.

items.name: Fell-Walker's Ring
items.lore: Frost-blue iron.

items.name: Frostweaver's Silk Mantle
items.lore: Woven ice that never melts.

items.name: Winter-Wolf Fang Torc
items.lore: A winter wolf's fang on a frozen chain.

items.name: Wraith-Shroud Charm
items.lore: A scrap of something that was never cloth.

items.name: Moor-Ward Bracer
items.lore: Silver runes on black iron.

items.name: Frost-Stone Shard Ring
items.lore: A chip of a frost-stone, faintly humming.

items.name: Wight-Bane Belt
items.lore: Rowan and silver.

items.name: Moon-Watcher's Mantle
items.lore: Grey wool, a moon stitched in silver.

items.name: Winterwolf-Hide Bracer
items.lore: White hide, very warm.

items.name: Pack-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Iron, with a wolf's head struck through.

items.name: Frost-Bear Claw Torc
items.lore: Three claws, rimed with frost.

items.name: Trapper's Fur Mantle
items.lore: Einar's own work, bear fur and wolf fur.

items.name: Fenrir-Soldier's Ring
items.lore: Black iron, a wolf's head.

items.name: Camp-Breaker's Belt
items.lore: Heavy, scarred leather.

items.name: Mystic's Moon-Bowl Charm
items.lore: A bowl of black stone. A moon floats in it, even in daylight.

items.name: Howe-Watcher's Bracer
items.lore: Silver and bone, carved with the moon.

items.name: King's Scout Mantle
items.lore: The King's blue under white fur.

items.name: Marshal's Oath-Ring
items.lore: The King's March's oath, in silver.

items.name: Howe-Road Belt
items.lore: Huscarl's leather, the King's hammer on the buckle.
